description: Adds, renames, requires, removes or reorders the fields of a sign-up form, the things a participant fills in before getting in. Take it when the form asks too much or the wrong thing. A host says: "I only need name and email, drop the phone number." It needs the session, the webinar and the fields as they stand on the site now, so read the form first. A field can be given a title, marked required, given choices, or removed. The kind of field is fixed by its place in the form: text, checkbox, textarea, hidden or dropdown. A full order list removes every field not named in it, so use it only on purpose. It writes on your site, participants see the new form on their next visit and existing registrants keep what they entered. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: form fields, drop a field, ask for the phone number, sign-up form

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

fields.description: The field changes. One entry per field.

options.description: Dropdown only: one option per line, optionally value::Label.

remove.description: true deletes this field from the form.

required.description: true when the participant must fill this field. Not for a hidden field.

slot.description: The slot, e.g. ar_custom_1 or ar_custom_9, as wi_get_registration_fields returned it.

title.description: The label the participant reads, in the host's own words.

type.description: The kind of field. Must match the slot; only state it to be explicit.

order.description: The complete slot list top to bottom. Only these slots appear afterwards, so this also removes every field not listed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_registration_fields
title: Change the registration form fields
